kind_notes.heading: learning
kind_notes.line: Letters, law and the habit of argument on paper. There is no book of learning to finish here, but a governor who sits in a city of scholars may in time gather tutors and philosophers into his household, and a head for administration.

kind_notes.heading: learning
kind_notes.line: A settlement keeps one god. Pulling a temple down is how a conquered city is weaned off a foreign cult.
